उड्डी उड्-डी (उद्-डी), cl. 1. 4. A. -डयते or
-डीयते, -डयितुम्, to fly up: Caus. -डपयति (-डा-
पयति?), to scare.

उड्-डीन, अस्, आ, अम्, flown up, flying up; (अम्),
n. flying as a bird; flying up, soaring.
उड्-डीयन, अम्, n. flying up, soaring.

उड्-डीयमान, अस्, आ, अम्, flying up, soaring, one
who flies or soars.

उड्डीश उड्डीश, अस्, m. a work so called,
containing charms and incantations; a N. of Śiva.
